plugins.description: Prevent and recover from disk-full errors in Cowork session VMs and Claude Code environments. Clears caches, temp files, build artifacts, and node_modules in phased cleanup.

skills.name: vm-cleanup
skills.description: Clean up disk space in the Claude working environment (Cowork session VM or Claude Code sandbox). Use this skill when the user says "clean VM", "clean disk", "free disk space", "disk full", "ENOSPC", "no space left", "clean session", "session cleanup", "disk cleanup", or when Bash commands fail with disk-full errors. Also use proactively before heavy operations like npm install or pip install in long sessions.
headings: Phase 1: Emergency (needs almost zero free space)
Remove Python bytecode (tiny files, frees inodes)
Remove build artifacts (recreate with build command)
Pro tip: Pair with a scheduled task
